source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
A psychic level 1 ability. During your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as a unit embarked in this one is picked for a **disembark move**, this unit may roll one D6 as its **psychic roll**, unless it is **battle-shocked**. If it does:

- A roll of 1 makes this unit battle-shocked.
- Until the turn ends, the disembarking unit's attacks against a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit get +1 to their **[wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)**.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

trigger.event: a unit embarked in this one is picked to disembark

effect.appliesTo: attacks by the disembarking unit targeting MONSTER or VEHICLE units
